in_sanskrit.name: Biki
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Vishnu's devotee
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Biki एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Biki is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bikshu', meaning 'a monk' or 'a beggar'. This name is often used for boys who are believed to be devotees of Lord Vishnu. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is known to be the preserver of the universe and is often depicted as a monk or a beggar, asking for donations to maintain balance and harmony in the world. The name Biki symbolizes humility, devotion, and a strong spiritual connection to the divine.
